record.field: Filing through the FIU's goAML portal. Required for the REAR (real estate) and STR/SAR (any activity) obligations under Decree-Law 10/2025 + Cabinet 134/2025.

Sanctions, PEP, adverse media, and TFS screening. Distinct from goAML filing. Required for any money-touching transition (G15) and for the freeze workflow (G30). The TFS portion of this capability is gated on EOCN Notification Alert System registration — a separate obligation from goAML registration that makes the 24-hour freeze clock achievable.

Listing on Trakheesi, with the permit number on every advert. Required for any listing to be published.
Statutory registration of tenancies through Ejari. Required for any lease to be valid in Dubai.

Project registration with the regulator, dedicated project escrow account, sales permit, Oqood interim registration. Required for any off-plan sale.
Mollak-registered accounts, RERA-approved budget, segregated funds. Required for any service-charge collection.

UAE e-invoicing has at least three distinct tracks with different deadlines, not one: Phase 1 (revenue ≥ AED 50m — ASP appointment by 30 October 2026, go-live 1 January 2027), Phase 2 (revenue below AED 50m — ASP appointment by 31 March 2027, go-live 1 July 2027, verified_secondary only), and a separate government-entity track whose go-live date is actively disputed between secondary sources (do not encode). Which deadline pair applies depends on the tenant's own revenue band — a fact this product cannot know unless the tenant declares it. Per Wave 3 remediation round 3: `einvoicing_revenue_band` is a required field precisely so the capability blocks until the tenant states which band they are in, rather than silently applying the Phase 1 deadline to a Phase 2 tenant.
